_comment: portal: the finish line. Origin at the base centre, y=0 is the ground; the disc lies in local XY at z=0 so a runner passes through along local Z. Two materials on one texture (the rock; the glow faces emit their own albedo) (hell_rock_albedo.png; the swirl is hell_props_albedo.png), one UV set, no skin, no animation. PortalCollision is two uprights and a lintel shipped as a `-colonly` node (the disc has none); Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` stays 1 and `max_tris` counts only what is drawn.
